{{Current events|year=2025|month=04|day=30|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[US–UK airstrikes on Yemen]]
***The [[Royal Air Force]] launches [[airstrike]]s on buildings they claimed were used by the [[Houthis]] to manufacture [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]]s south of [[Sanaa]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/uk-military-launches-airstrikes-with-us-targeting-yemens-houthi-rebels/ (CTV News)]
*[[Puntland–Somaliland dispute]]
**[[Las Anod conflict (2023–present)|Las Anod conflict]], [[List of Puntland–Somaliland prisoner exchanges|Puntland–Somaliland prisoner exchange]]
***[[Puntland]] releases fifteen [[prisoners of war]] in exchange for [[Somaliland]] releasing eleven combatants captured during the conflict in the contested [[Sool region]]. This is the second [[prisoner exchange]] of prisoners captured during the conflict in [[Las Anod]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Apr/201344/puntland_and_somaliland_exchange_prisoners_captured_during_las_anod_conflict.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://hornobserver.com/articles/3308/Puntland-and-Somaliland-Set-to-Exchange-Prisoners-in-Landmark-Agreement (Horn Observer)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[North Korean involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[South Korea]]n [[National Intelligence Service (South Korea)|intelligence]] claims [[North Korea]]n troops have suffered around 4,700 casualties, including about 600 fatalities among 15,000 soldiers. Their combat capability has also significantly improved, with increasing proficiency in new weapons such as [[drone]]s. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/north-korean-soldiers-ukraine-1.7522405 (CBC News)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[Colombia]]n [[Government of Colombia|government]] says fifteen [[National Police of Colombia|police officers]] and twelve [[Military Forces of Colombia|soldiers]] have been killed over the past two weeks in targeted attacks by the [[Gulf Clan]] [[drug cartel|cartel]] and other [[Organised crime in Colombia|armed groups]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czx1e0x762lo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Ukraine–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] and [[Ukraine]] sign the [[Ukraine–United States Mineral Resources Agreement]] to share profits from the future sales of Ukraine's [[mineral resource classification|mineral]] and [[world energy resources|energy reserves]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5ypw7pn9q3o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Israel fires]]
**[[Wildfire]]s rage out of control in at least 100 different locations throughout [[Israel]] and the [[West Bank]], prompting the [[Cabinet of Israel|Israeli government]] to declare a [[state of emergency]] and forcing [[Emergency evacuation|evacuations]] near [[Jerusalem]]. At least 40 people are reportedly injured due to the fires. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/30/middleeast/israel-wildfires-jerusalem-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Parliament of Kenya|Kenyan parliament]] [[Member of Parliament (Kenya)|member]] [[Charles Were|Charles Ong'ondo]] is shot to death in [[Nairobi]] by unknown gunmen on a motorcycle in an apparent [[assassination]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/creq4gz0grzo (BBC News)]
*[[Belarus–United States relations]]
**An American citizen detained in [[Belarus]] after being accused of being part of a US-backed coup to oust [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] is released from the country. [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] confirms the release. [https://www.kcra.com/article/american-detainee-belarus-freed/64635602 (KCRA)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The world's oldest person, [[Brazil]]ian [[nun]] [[Inah Canabarro Lucas]], dies at the age of 116 years and 326 days. The new [[List of oldest living people|oldest living person]] is [[United Kingdom|British]] [[supercentenarian]] [[Ethel Caterham]], who is the last person born in the [[1900s|1900s decade]], the last living subject of [[King of the United Kingdom|King]] [[Edward VII]], and the [[List of British supercentenarians|oldest British person ever]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr4nv0g15xyo (BBC News)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2025/05/01/british-woman-115-named-worlds-oldest-person/ (''The Telegraph'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Taiwan]], [[Somaliland–Taiwan relations]]
**Amid strengthening ties between [[Taiwan]] and [[Somaliland]], the [[Federal Government of Somalia|Somali government]] [[travel ban|bans]] [[Passport of Taiwan|Taiwanese passport]] holders from Somalia, citing [[United Nations General Assembly Resolution 2758|UN Resolution 2758]] and the ''[[One China policy]]''. Taiwan lodges a protest with Somalia and claims [[China]] instigated the ban. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyqr1wgz4eo (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/taiwan-says-somalia-bans-entry-its-citizens-amid-somaliland-dispute-2025-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[New Zealand–Philippines relations]]
**[[New Zealand]] [[Minister of Defence (New Zealand)|defence minister]] [[Judith Collins]] and [[Philippine]] [[Secretary of National Defense (Philippines)|defense secretary]] [[Gilbert Teodoro]] sign a [[visiting forces agreement]] in [[Manila]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/04/30/new-zealand-philippines-status-of-visiting-forces-agreement/c9dae4ce-259a-11f0-ae6d-e4db528eba27_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
